correctness.rationale: The exact 16-vertex Clebsch adjacency and all 2^16 independent subsets are checked; the independence number is five and proper four-colorings exist. Two self-contained code paths enumerate every proper four-coloring without omitting or duplicating assignments, using different graph construction and search orders. They independently generate exactly 57,600 legal recoloring edges by two distinct transition tests, then enumerate all 2,640 connected components and recompute distances from every nonsingleton state. The full 960-component orbit and the split frozen orbits follow by explicitly verified generator actions, not by a sampled symmetry argument. Both packages were replayed successfully with recorded outputs.

value.rationale: At minimum chromatic palette size, reachability and absorbing states of single-site proper recoloring are natural mathematical invariants with direct implications for reducibility of the corresponding finite-state sampling dynamics. The nontrivial 960 equal-size movable classes plus two frozen symmetry types give a complete structural benchmark on a canonical 4-chromatic strongly regular graph. The component and orbit classification is not an automatic rewriting of the known chromatic polynomial.
